captions.detailed: A naval deck cannon mounted on a heavy cylindrical pedestal with a wide, bolted base. Atop the pedestal sits a rotating carriage with vertical side cheeks and a top horizontal cross-brace. A long cylindrical gun barrel with a flared muzzle and a brass-colored rear cap is mounted between the cheeks on a horizontal trunnion. The assembly is colored in dark charcoal gray with light gray bolt accents and a brass-colored end cap on the barrel, allowing the carriage to rotate continuously on the vertical yaw axis and the barrel to pitch on the horizontal elevation axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a naval deck cannon mounted on a heavy cylindrical pedestal. The model must feature a rotating carriage on a vertical continuous joint, and an elevating cylindrical gun barrel with a brass rear cap mounted on a horizontal revolute joint between the carriage cheeks.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in three parts: a fixed pedestal, a rotating carriage, and an elevating barrel. The pedestal is built using a central cylinder with wide bottom and top flanges, detailed with an array of small cylinders representing mounting bolts. The carriage is constructed from a base plate, two vertical box-shaped side cheeks, and a top cross-brace. The barrel is modeled as a stepped cylinder with a flared muzzle, a horizontal trunnion cylinder, and a brass-colored rear end cap. Two joints are defined: a continuous yaw joint connecting the carriage to the pedestal, and a revolute pitch joint connecting the barrel to the carriage.
